meta.name: arboreto
meta.description: Infer gene regulatory networks (GRNs) from gene expression data using scalable algorithms (GRNBoost2, GENIE3). Use when analyzing transcriptomics data (bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq) to identify transcription factor-target gene relationships and regulatory interactions. Supports distributed computation for large-scale datasets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从基因表达数据推断转录因子与靶基因的调控关系
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要分析RNA-seq数据来发现基因间的调控连接
copy.tagline_en: Infer transcription factor-target gene relationships from gene expression data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to discover regulatory interactions from RNA-seq data

howto.what: 装上此技能后，Claude可以根据基因表达数据（如RNA-seq）推断基因调控网络，识别哪些转录因子调控哪些靶基因，并输出带有重要性分数的调控关系列表。支持大规模数据，可利用本地多核或远程集群加速计算。
howto.when: 当用户要求分析转录组数据（如批量RNA-seq、单细胞RNA-seq）并识别转录因子与靶基因的调控关系时触发。

say.text: 根据这份表达数据，用GRNBoost2推断基因调控网络。
say.note: 会返回TF、靶基因和重要性分数。

say.text: 换用GENIE3再跑一遍，看看结果对比。
say.note: 经典随机森林算法，适合对比验证。

say.text: 帮我筛选重要性大于0.5的调控链接。
say.note: 只保留高置信度的TF-靶基因对。

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to infer gene regulatory networks from expression data (e.g., RNA-seq), identifying which transcription factors regulate which target genes and outputting ranked links with importance scores. Supports large-scale datasets via local multi-core or remote cluster parallelization.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to analyze transcriptomics data (bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq) to identify transcription factor-target gene relationships.

say_en.text: Infer a gene regulatory network from this expression data using GRNBoost2.
say_en.note: Returns TF, target, and importance scores.

say_en.text: Run GENIE3 again and compare the results.
Filter regulatory links with importance above 0.5.
